chapters.title: Narshe: the assault (Terra)
chapters.intro: Terra, Biggs and Wedge march on Narshe in Magitek Armor. Nothing to collect before the Esper scene.

items.t: Boss: Whelk (shell + head). Do not hit the shell with lightning: it counters. Aim at the head; Terra has the Magitek command.
Put everyone in the back row: physical damage taken is halved (see Formulas).

chapters.title: Narshe: the escape (Locke and the Moogles)
chapters.intro: Terra wakes up at an old man's house, then Locke takes over in the mines with the Moogles.

items.t: Elixir: examine the clock in the room where Terra wakes up (hidden item).
Sleeping Bag x2: given by the old man when you wake up.
Mog learns the dance Twilight Requiem (Dusk Requiem) in the very first fight with the Moogles.
MithrilKnife: common steal from the Guard Leader (Locke). Steal it before killing him.
Boss: Marshal / Guard Leader (with 2 Lobo).
The 2 chests here CHANGE later: left one Sleeping Bag → Elixir; right one Fenix Down → Pod Bracelet (Guard Bracelet, World of Ruin). Leave the RIGHT chest closed if you want the Pod Bracelet.

chapters.title: Adventurers' school and the road to Figaro
chapters.intro: Narshe shuts its doors on you. The adventurers' school (northwest) has 3 rooms with loot before you head to Figaro.

items.t: School bucket (examine it): restores HP/MP and cures statuses, unlimited.
Rightmost room (Environmental Science): one chest is a monster (Lobo); one pot holds a Tincture (Ether).

chapters.title: Figaro Castle
chapters.intro: Terra and Edgar. Take Locke's Mithril Shield BEFORE talking to Edgar: Locke leaves afterwards. Kefka attacks and the castle sinks.

items.last: The castle sinks into the sand after the Floating Continent: these 4 chests cannot be reopened in the World of Ruin
The castle sinks into the sand after the Floating Continent: these 4 chests cannot be reopened in the World of Ruin
The castle sinks into the sand after the Floating Continent: these 4 chests cannot be reopened in the World of Ruin
The castle sinks into the sand after the Floating Continent: these 4 chests cannot be reopened in the World of Ruin

items.t: Edgar joins the party (Auto Crossbow). Story event, no choice.
Tool shop: NoiseBlaster and Bio Blaster (handy against Magitek). Discounts when Edgar is the party leader.
Grab the 4 chests of the castle now: it will vanish from the World of Balance (the World of Ruin basement is a different dungeon).

chapters.title: Figaro Cave (first visit)
chapters.intro: Escape under the desert. The 3 chests in the cave are variable-content chests: Fenix Down / Tincture now, X-Potion / Thunder Rod with Locke, Hero Ring in the World of Ruin. One roll only.

items.t: Advice: do NOT touch any of these chests now. Each chest is filled with a single item depending on progress: the first one you open is the only one you will get (the best one is in the World of Ruin: Hero Ring).
Possible steal from Urok: Remedy is better than Tonic.
Do not step on the tile just in front of the exit: it permanently removes the chance to see the flipping-out scene in battle.

chapters.title: South Figaro
chapters.intro: Shops, town and the rich man's house. Barrel contents change after Locke's scenario (the "later" item is better).

items.hint: Clock in the big house in the northwest (hidden room behind)

items.t: Several town items are variable (Tonic → X-Potion, Eyedrop → Remedy, Antidote → Tent, Green Cherry → Tent, Soft → Elixir): opening now = missing the "later" version.
Elixir: clock in the big house in the northwest (hidden room behind it).
Weapon shop: RegalCutlass (Terra), MithrilBlade (Locke), Edgar's tools.
Relic shop: Jewel Ring (anti-Petrify, essential later) and Star Pendants.
A secret passage leads to a merchant upstairs (3rd door: 500/1500/1000 gil and a monster chest).

chapters.title: Duncan's Hut and Mt. Kolts
chapters.intro: Edgar finds his brother Sabin. Fight against Vargas.

items.hint: Bucket in the starting hut

items.t: Tonic: bucket in the starting hut of the chapter.

items.hint: Hidden room to the right of the path/stairway

items.t: Sabin joins mid-fight against Vargas (+ 2 Ipooh). Finish with the Raging Fist Blitz.
Pummel (Blitz 1) is already known by Sabin.

chapters.title: Returner Hideout
chapters.intro: Banon invites you to join the Returners. The group then splits into three scenarios.

items.last: Returner Hideout is not accessible in the World of Ruin (to be confirmed)

items.t: Gauntlet: only if you ACCEPT Banon's offer immediately.
items.lost: Gauntlet: obtained only by accepting Banon's offer right away (otherwise you get the Genji Glove)

items.t: Genji Glove: decline Banon's offer (1 "No" = the Returner in the storeroom, 3 "No" = the one who interrupts the conversation). Exclusive with the Gauntlet here; another Genji Glove is in the Sealed Gate cave.
Note where you exit the hideout: a hidden passage in Banon's room leads to the Lete River and later to the Veldt.
Hideout shop: first Potions (Hi-Potions) and Eyedrops.

chapters.title: Lete River and Terra's scenario
chapters.intro: Raft escape then the three teams: Terra (Narshe), Sabin (Mt. Kolts → Veldt), Locke (South Figaro). Suggested order: Terra, Sabin, Locke.

items.t: Boss: Ultros (first fight, on the raft). If Banon falls: Game Over. Terra and Banon in the back row.
Mog: Water Harmony can ONLY be learned in water (Lete River or Serpent Trench). Neither area is accessible afterwards.
items.lost: Water Harmony (Mog's dance): fight in water (Lete or Serpent Trench) with Mog in the party. Impossible after the World of Balance

items.hint: Moogle room (Rune Edge; Ribbon in the World of Ruin)

items.t: The chest in the Moogle room holds the Rune Edge. In the World of Ruin it will hold a Ribbon: take one OR the other, not both. Rune Edge: stronger than the RegalCutlass but costs 12-18 MP per guaranteed critical; many players leave the chest for the Ribbon.
Security checkpoint: follow the sparkling light, otherwise the 9 rotating lights trigger a battle. Only here: Darkside (Rage); appears at 25% in the checkpoint.

chapters.title: Sabin's scenario: camp, forest, Phantom Train
chapters.intro: Imperial Camp near Doma (Cyan), Phantom Forest, Phantom Train. Shadow is recruitable (optional).

items.hint: Big tent: kick / "Hit" the chest (otherwise nothing)
items.lost: The Imperial Camp can no longer be visited after this scenario (≈)

items.hint: Tent behind the 2-chest tent
items.lost: The Imperial Camp can no longer be visited after this scenario (≈)

items.hint: 2-chest tent, left chest = monster (Satellite)
items.last: The Imperial Camp can no longer be visited after this scenario (≈)

items.hint: 2-chest tent, right chest
items.lost: The Imperial Camp can no longer be visited after this scenario (≈)

items.t: Cyan joins Sabin; he knows his SwdTechs (the gauge fills 2x faster in the mod).
Star Pendant: big tent chest → Kick / "Hit" (cat disguise) to open it; if you leave it, nothing.
Green Beret: dropped by the Satellite (monster chest in the 2-chest tent).
Black Belt: rare drop from the Captain; no other for a long time.
items.lost: Black Belt (rare drop from the camp Captain)

items.t: Shadow: optional recruit (3,000 gil in Kohlingen later, otherwise here at the camp). He may leave at random before the Phantom Train.
Healing spring in the forest (top exit). Three ghost fights before the train.

items.hint: Cabin car, top-left corner (hidden)
items.last: You cannot return to the Phantom Train

items.hint: Dining car, behind the waiters
items.lost: You cannot return to the Phantom Train

items.hint: Siegfried's compartment, empty tile on the left
items.last: You cannot return to the Phantom Train

items.hint: Right tile: you cannot stand facing it, so it is unreachable
items.lost: You cannot return to the Phantom Train

items.last: You cannot return to the Phantom Train

items.t: Boss: Ghost Train (weak to fire; Fenix Downs hurt it). Optional: Siegfried (100 HP) → Green Cherry; Apparition (monster chest) → Hyper Wrist.
Hidden Tent in the top-left corner of the cabin car; Tent on the left of Siegfried's compartment (you cannot face the right tile: Fairy Ring lost).
Earrings: dining car chest behind the waiters.
Next car: 4 chests (Fenix Down, Sniper Sight, Fenix Down, monster chest M-TekArmor). There is no way back to the Train.

chapters.title: Sabin's scenario: Baren, Veldt, Mobliz, Crescent, Trench
chapters.intro: Sabin and Cyan jump into Baren Falls, meet Gau on the Veldt, cross Mobliz and the Serpent Trench to Nikeah.

items.t: Shadow leaves the group at the falls. Before that: unequip his items, relics and Esper (Ninja Gear and RunningShoes to Sabin, Atlas Armlet to Cyan).
Boss: Rhizopas (60 s after the Opinicus). Common drop: Remedy.

items.hint: Clock in the carrier-pigeon house

items.t: Gau: on the Veldt, throw him Dried Meat (buy it in Mobliz). Sabin and Cyan must be alive for the scene.
Tintinabar: reward from the wounded soldier after delivering the 5 parcels.
Mobliz shop: Dried Meat (at least 1), Kotetsu for Cyan. Keep 2,500 gil.
Gau's scene takes 500 gil from you if you have it (otherwise Cyan keeps it).
Tonic: small tile on the left (where Gau finds it).

items.last: The Serpent Trench is no longer accessible after this chapter: take both chests (RIGHT forks)

items.lost: The Serpent Trench is no longer accessible after this chapter: take both chests (RIGHT forks)

items.t: Take the right-hand forks: X-Potion (1st fork), Green Beret (2nd fork, marked tile to drain the water).

items.hint: Inn clock

items.t: Elixir: clock in the Nikeah inn.

chapters.title: Locke's scenario: South Figaro
chapters.intro: Locke infiltrates South Figaro and follows a secret passage (password: "Courage").

items.t: Merchant / officer: steal their clothes (Plumed Hat, Dirk) to proceed. Give the Cider to the old servant to reveal the secret passage.
Celes is freed: she joins the party (Runic, magic). First item: Clock Key.
Contents of the upper chest now: Thunder Rod (it breaks); later, Hero Ring (World of Ruin). Better to leave it closed.
Boss: Tunnel Armor (1,300 HP). Steal Air Lancet (rare) with Locke.

chapters.title: Reunion in Narshe
chapters.intro: The teams meet in Narshe to defend the Esper. Fight against Hell's Rider then Kefka. Afterwards: rest and preparations.

items.t: Boss: Hell's Rider (Lv 14) then Kefka (Lv 18, 3,000 HP, vulnerable to Stop). If the team is wiped you return to the save point at 1 HP and can steal again.
Peace Ring: dropped by Kefka (not very useful).

items.hint: Examine the clock in the Elder's House

items.t: Elixir: clock in the Elder's House.
Treasure room (east shack): Hyper Wrist, Sneak Ring, Wall Ring, ThiefKnife, Earrings, Elixir, 5,000 gil.
The Sprint Shoes chest in Narshe is only accessible once the town is open (after defending the Esper).
Weapon shop: Hawk Eye... for Locke; armor shop: Mithril Shld for everyone.

chapters.title: Kohlingen, Jidoor and Zozo
chapters.intro: You find Rachel in Kohlingen (Locke), then the Zozo tower where Terra is held.

items.hint: Barely visible chest in the big northeast house: back entrance
Clock in Rachel's house

items.t: Elixir: clock in Rachel's house. Green Beret: big house to the northeast (back entrance).
Shadow: 3,000 gil at the Kohlingen inn. He leaves at random afterwards; before the Floating Continent decide whether to bring him (see Floating Continent).
Fuma/Flame Scrolls (Shadow) at the weapon shop.

items.hint: In one of the buckets of Owzer's mansion

items.t: Tincture: one of the buckets of Owzer's mansion.

items.hint: Small room behind the obvious door
Behind a wall that opens when the clock reads 6:10:50
Dadaluma's room, side chest
Dadaluma's room, side chest

items.t: Chain Saw: chest behind a wall that opens when the clock is set to 6:10:50.
Tincture (top tower), Potion and Tincture (pots on the spiral stairs), Fire Knuckle (small room), Thief Glove (High Tower), RunningShoes and X-Potion (two chests in Dadaluma's room).
Boss: Dadaluma (Zozo, Lv 22). Common steal ThiefKnife, rare Thief Glove.
Ramuh: Magicite found in Zozo (collected after the episode with Terra).

chapters.title: Opera House, Albrook, Tzen, Maranda and Vector
chapters.intro: Ultros at the opera against Setzer, then the infiltration of Vector.

items.t: Auction House: Golem and Zone Seeker (Espers for sale), Angel Wings, Angel Ring: random rotation.
Setzer joins after the opera (balloon plan). The opera allows limited failures: 3 retries then Game Over.
Boss: Ultros (4th position, 2,550 HP each). Use Ramuh and Earrings.

items.hint: Clock in the hallway between the armor shop and the cafe

items.t: Elixir: clock in the hallway between the armor shop and the cafe. Potion: barrel near the inn; Tincture: pot in the weapon shop; Warp Stone: dock crate.
Wall Ring x4 (bosses), Earrings, Hero Ring (1-2), Poison Claw for Sabin.
Seraph: buy it from a crook in Tzen (3,000 gil); later only 10 gil in the World of Ruin.
Revivify (bottom crate, west of the south exit) and Remedy (one of the 2 crates near the couple): free.
Lola's dialogue depends on the Mobliz parcel. Carrier pigeon: read it before leaving.
Weapon shop: Blossom (wind dirk). Buy it now if you want it.
Guardian: indestructible. Run, or Confuse a member who uses the Smoke Bomb.

chapters.title: Magitek Research Facility
chapters.intro: Descend into the pit then the lab. After Number 128 there is no coming back. Pick up EVERYTHING before leaving.

Blizzard and Zephyr Cape: hidden room among the Imperial crates, under the 5th crate (facing the first crate: 5 steps down, right, 1 step back).

items.hint: Hidden to the left of the bottom-left tube in the tube room
items.lost: Research Facility inaccessible afterwards

items.t: Boss: Number 024 (Esper room), then Ifrit (3,300 HP) and Shiva (3,000 HP).
Ifrit: Magicite after the Ifrit/Shiva fight. Take both.
items.lost: Ifrit and Shiva: the Magicites are lost if you leave the room without picking them up

items.t: Shiva: Magicite after the fight.
items.lost: Ifrit and Shiva (see above)

items.t: Break Blade (Stoneblade): hidden chest to the left of the bottom-left tube in the tube room (spell: Break).
Boss: Number 128 (3,276 HP) + blades. After the fight: 6 Espers (Bismarck, Maduin, Unicorn, Catoblepas, Phantom, Carbuncle).
Number 128: rare steal Tempest (Kazekiri) (also a common drop); another Tempest is in the Sealed Gate.

chapters.title: Narshe: alliance, Mog and the Sealed Gate
chapters.intro: The Espers of Vector, Terra's flashback, then the defense of Narshe and the Sealed Gate cave.

items.t: Mog: by defending the Moogle against Lone Wolf. If you chase the treasure (Gold Hairpin), Mog is LOST.
items.lost: Mog: save the Moogle (do not chase Lone Wolf for the Gold Hairpin)

items.t: Mog dances already learned at this stage: Wind Rhapsody (plains near Narshe), Forest Nocturne, Desert Lullaby, Earth Blues (slopes of Mt. Kolts), Twilight Requiem, Love Serenade (Zozo).
Narshe shops: Hawk Eye for Locke, Tiara for Terra, Gold Shld/Helmet.

Kefka (triggers the Sealed Gate). Then Esper Valigarmanda/Midgardsormr (Narshe, World of Ruin).

items.t: Observation post house (if score ≥ 67): X-Potion, Cherub Down..., 41,000 gil in total (8,000 + 13,000 + 20,000), hidden Elixir to the south, Flame Sabre in the stove.

chapters.title: Thamasa and the Espers
chapters.intro: Cyan, Strago, Relm: the mountain behind Thamasa, the burning house, then Kefka's attack.

items.t: Strago joins (Lores) after the burning house. He learns a Lore when he sees an enemy cast it.
Barrels (Echo Screen, Green Cherry, Soft, Eyedrop, Fenix Down), Memento Ring: Strago's room upstairs.
If you did not unequip Shadow before his nap, he takes his gear with him when he leaves.

items.hint: 3rd room, left door then next room, right door
items.lost: The burning house disappears after the fire

items.hint: 3rd room, right door
items.lost: The burning house disappears after the fire

items.t: Boss: Flame Eater (burning house; avoid fire).
Fire Rod (3rd room, right door) and Ice Rod (3rd room, left door, next room, right door).
Lore: Self-Destruct, by Confusing the Balloons.

items.last: The mountain is no longer accessible once Relm is recruited (≈)

items.lost: The mountain is no longer accessible once Relm is recruited (≈)
The mountain is no longer accessible once Relm is recruited (≈)

items.hint: 1st room of the mountain: Heal Rod
items.lost: The mountain is no longer accessible once Relm is recruited (≈)

items.t: Boss: Ultros (3rd fight, 22,000 HP). Relm joins when his HP drops to ~10,240; Sketch makes him flee.
Heal Rod (1st room), Chocobo Suit and Tabby Suit (broken-bridge maze, via the upper collapse tile), X-Potion (loose tile far right).
Lore: White Wind, when Venobennu uses it in front of Strago.
After Kefka's attack the Espers are killed (Magicites). Interceptor is left behind in Thamasa.

chapters.title: Veldt, Rages and Lores before the end
chapters.intro: This is the last chance before the switch: Rages and Lores outside the World of Ruin.

items.t: No dance, Rage or Lore is lost for good here, except Water Harmony (already covered). Many enemies are only met in the World of Balance: Grenade Rage, Gaia Gear (rare steal from Briareus), Magic Urn...
Lores to learn now with Strago: Doom, Dischord, Lv.3 Confuse, Lv.4 Flare, Lv.5 Death, Transfusion, Roulette, Traveler (Confuse an Unseelie outside South Figaro).

chapters.title: Floating Continent
chapters.intro: Last dungeon of the World of Balance. There is NO way back: the continent collapses. Bring Shadow if you want him, otherwise he stays.

items.lost: The World of Balance is destroyed after the Floating Continent: no way back
The World of Balance is destroyed after the Floating Continent: no way back

items.last: The World of Balance is destroyed after the Floating Continent: no way back

items.lost: The World of Balance is destroyed after the Floating Continent: no way back

items.t: Shadow (optional): for him to survive, wait for the countdown to hit 0:05 on the island before coming back. Jumping too early = Shadow lost for good.
items.lost: Shadow: during the escape wait until 0:05 before jumping (6:00 total), otherwise he is lost

items.t: Murasame: blue orb east of the entrance. Beret: blue orb below the save point (Relm). Elixir: small plateau with an orb (cracks in the floor).
Boss: Air Force (then Ultima Weapon 24,000 HP, Kefka and Gestahl). Steal from Ultima Weapon: Ribbon (common), Elixir (rare).
Last chance: Genji Glove (rare steal from the Dragon, with ThiefKnife), Earrings/Angel Ring (steals), Rages and Lores unique to the World of Balance.

chapters.title: Solitary Island and first steps
chapters.intro: Celes wakes up alone with Cid. Feed him fish: his hidden health decides whether he survives, and his death is permanent.

items.t: Cid: give him fish (Fish +16, Yummy +32, Rotten −4, Slow −16). At 256 he is cured for good; below 30 he dies (permanent, and it changes Celes' dialogue).
Equip Celes with an Amulet or Ribbon against Bone Powder (Zombie = Game Over).
Quetzalli: Magicite washed up on the Solitary Island beach.
Albrook, Tzen, Mobliz, Nikeah, South Figaro, Kohlingen: same chests as in the World of Balance (nothing more if they were already taken).
Sabin: save the child before the collapse (6:00). Shop: Jewel Ring (last chance), Poison Claw.
Seraph: only 10 gil here if you did not buy it earlier.
Heal Rod (end of the hallway): do not miss it; Pearl Rod, Tincture, Magicite, Drainer (optional).

chapters.title: Mobliz, Nikeah, South Figaro, buried Figaro
chapters.intro: The trio: Terra (Mobliz), then the Crimson Robbers quest (Edgar disguised as Gerad).

items.t: Fenrir: given by the child at the entrance after Humbaba leaves.
Terra does not join yet: come back after beating Humbaba (Narshe).
Enhancers x3 (+7 magic), Diamond Vest, Gale Hairpin.
Gold Lance, DiamondArmor, Amulets (enough for 4), RunningShoes.
Gerad (Edgar) leaves the inn with the Crimson Robbers: follow him.

locs.name: Cave to South Figaro (World of Ruin)

items.t: Ether, X-Potion, Hero Ring: the cave chests only fill once; if you already took them in the World of Balance, these are the old items.
Buried castle chests: Crystal Helm, Gravity Rod, X-Potion, Ether (4-chest room); Regal Crown (left door); Soul Sabre (middle armor of the treasure room).
Boss: 4 Tentacles (Grab). You can let the Robbers go.

chapters.title: Kohlingen, Darill's Tomb, Setzer
chapters.intro: Setzer drowns his sorrows in Kohlingen. Darill's Tomb holds strong equipment.

items.t: Setzer: at the Kohlingen bar; Celes brings him around. Buy Dice (5,000 gil) and Doom Darts (Colosseum).
Genji Helmet (bottom-right path), Crystal Mail (bottom-left room), Czarina Gown (Relm), Man Eater (room after the 2nd turtle), Exp. Egg hidden behind the tomb carving.
Boss: Dullahan. Monster chest Angler Whelk: kill head AND shell together for 2 Dragon Claws.
items.lost: Dragon Claw: only source = Angler Whelk, head and shell must die together

items.t: Bahamut: drop from Deathgaze (random flying encounter).
Crystal Shld/Mail (x2), Dark Gear (Sabin).

chapters.title: Narshe: Mog, Umaro, Valigarmanda
chapters.intro: Narshe revisited: the mine, the Moogles, the snow, Umaro.

items.t: Mog: in the Moogle cave (wall Mog stares at); you get the Moogle Charm (avoids battles). With 4 characters, Mog waits on the Falcon.
Ribbon: only if the Rune Edge was left in the chest. Elixir and Pod Bracelet: only if the mine chests are untouched.
Weapon shop: locked, needs Locke (he picks the lock).
Valigarmanda: snowfields; Force Shld from the Ice Dragon.
Mog: Snowman Rondo (last dance).
Umaro: Mog must talk to him. Without Mog he will not join (you can come back).
Midgardsormr: carved bone in the Sasquatch room (triggers the Yeti).
Gauntlet: lower chest after the upper room; Ether: upper chest; X-Ether.

chapters.title: Mobliz: Humbaba and Terra
chapters.intro: Humbaba (2) removes 2 characters from the party; Terra transforms permanently.

items.t: Terra: after the second fight against Humbaba (60,000 HP). She has permanent Morph.
Humbaba Breath removes 2 characters from the party: you find them again on the Falcon.

chapters.title: Zozo, Mt. Zozo, Cyan
chapters.intro: The pigeon, Mt. Zozo and the Storm Dragon.

items.t: Ice Shld, Red Cap (+25% HP), Thunder Shld, Aegis Shld (cave chests), Gold Hairpin (left opening outside).
Boss: Storm Dragon (42,000 HP, weak to lightning). The trapped chest releases the dragon.
Cyan: only with 3 characters in the fight; otherwise he waits on the Falcon. Machinery Manual / Book of Secrets: Cyan's chest.
Rust-Rid (1,000 gil): on sale only if the pigeon was sent to Zozo.

chapters.title: Veldt, Gau, Shadow, Relm
chapters.intro: Gau is recruited in Veldt fights. The Cave on the Veldt hides Relm (or Shadow).

items.t: Gau: Veldt fights with a free slot (about 57% encounter chance).
Shadow: rescued here only if you waited for him on the Floating Continent; otherwise Relm.
Rage Ring (room with the 4 hunters), Striker (switch room), Tiger Fangs (after Death Warden).
Lakshmi: drop from Chadarnook. Relm joins afterwards.
Moogle Suit (left door of the 1st room), Relic Ring (hidden behind the 3 doors). Only the LEFT door continues the dungeon.
Strago: play with Relm in the party. Interceptor is lost if a monster takes Dog Block from him.

chapters.title: Cyan's Dream (Doma)
chapters.intro: Cyan's Dream is only accessible here. Take everything before finishing.

items.t: Elixir and Ether (clock in the bedroom), X-Potion, Fenix Down, Beads (small room on the outside wall).

items.lost: Cyan's Dream cannot be replayed: anything not taken is lost
Cyan's Dream cannot be replayed: anything not taken is lost
Cyan's Dream cannot be replayed: anything not taken is lost

items.last: Cyan's Dream cannot be replayed: anything not taken is lost

items.t: Alexander: Magicite in the throne room.
Boss: Wrexsoul (+ 2 Soul Savers). Do NOT use Banish: without having damaged him you lose the Pod Bracelet.
Cyan learns all remaining SwdTechs (Tempest, Oblivion).
Genji Glove (1st train car), Flame Shld (2nd car, needs the Lump of Metal), Ice Shld and X-Potion (train maze), Masamune after Wrexsoul.
Enemies unique to the dream (Weredragon, Alluring Rider, Pandora, Parasite, Coco): for your Rage and Lore lists (Holy, Doom, Roulette).
items.lost: Rages/Lores from Cyan's Dream: encounter them before finishing

chapters.title: Ancient Castle and Phoenix Cave
chapters.intro: Two major optional dungeons.

items.t: Wing Edge (left entrance room), Ether (right), Doom Darts (Master Tonberry's cave), X-Potion and Magicite Shard (left cave).
Master Tonberry (monster chest, 22,000 HP). Put it to sleep, magic only.
Odin: statue in the throne room; Raiden: petrified queen (needs Odin).
Punisher (right), Master's Scroll (left, guarded by Samurai Soul: do not flee), Blizzard Orb and Gold Hairpin (right room), X-Ether (bucket in the queen's room).
items.lost: Master's Scroll: if you flee Samurai Soul you can no longer fight it

items.t: Boss: Blue Dragon (underground hall) → Zantetsuken.
Locke: three teams in the Phoenix Cave.
Phoenix: Locke's chest.
Wing Edge (bridge or fall: 400 damage), Ribbon (solidified lava), Dragon Horn (guarded by the Red Dragon).

chapters.title: Zone Eater (Gogo) and others
chapters.intro: Gogo is the last character.

items.t: Gogo: the last character to recruit (inside the Zone Eater).
Genji Armor (right side), Magical Brsh (left), FakeMustache (far left), Zephyr Cape, Hero Ring (between two falls), Tack Star (falling ceiling), Thunder Shld, Ether, Red Jacket.
Safety Bit, Air Anchor (hidden chest on the right), Genji Shld, Stunner, Force Armor, Gem Box (roof: Magic Master, Ultima on his death).
Fanatics' Tower: only Magic Urn (useful Rage) and Holy Dragon (Holy Lance) are worth not missing.
Northwest Cave: Hero Ring.

chapters.title: Kefka's Tower and Colosseum
chapters.intro: Three teams, a single path. Last chance for everything: Rages, Lores, items.

items.t: Coronet, Fixed Dice, Minerva, Tack Star, Force Shld, Force Armor, Ribbon (several), Red Cap, Gauntlet, Nutkin Suit, Hero Ring, Aegis Shld (hidden, 11-step route), Megalixir, Rainbow Brsh.
Crusader: after the Skull Dragon (Dragon Seal).
Boss: Guardian (4-program cycle), the 3 Statues (Demon, Fiend, Goddess) then Kefka. Fiend: Force Field is only learned here.
items.lost: Force Field (Lore): only from Fiend in Kefka's Tower

items.t: The Colosseum lets you wager an item to win a rare item (see More > Colosseum).
